name: USAAF 63-foot Rescue Boat
blurb: A Hangar-only twin-screw 63-foot air-sea rescue launch: hard-chine hull, pilot house and cabin, mast, rails, guards, two twin .50 mounts, turning propellers and steerable rudders.
history: Fast rescue launches supported downed aircrew recovery around wartime operating areas. The sixty-three-foot class identity is documented in a U.S. transfer record, and its 15 ft 4 in beam over guards, three-blade screws and twin .50 mounts in a crash-boat history; the hull lines, 3.60 m height, deckhouse, mast and fittings here remain estimates pending a builder's plan.
